notes.title: v2.0 Patch notes and Discord server
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Fixed crash issue when entering the main menu scene
[*] Fixed text disappearance on right eye issue
[*] Fixed minor particle effects and other graphical issues
[*] Updated SteamVR plugin to the latest version
[*] Fixed a problem that caused the pause menu to not appear when required
[/list]

We have opened up a Moonleaf Studio Discord community server! Feel free to join by clicking the image below!
The Discord server can be used to report bugs and other in-game issues, get notifications about upcoming updates or just simply hang out with other people.
